user.title: Water tank
user.description: Pick the tank model: its volume is known, nothing else to enter. "Custom" asks for the size on the next step.

size.title: Tank size
size.description: Enter the shape and dimensions (rectangular: width x length x height, circular: diameter x height). "Freeform" (neither square nor round): no dimensions, you type the capacity; the learned curve follows the real shape. The capacity is entered on the next step.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: The level sensor is required. Without an inlet meter, water in is derived from the level and the outlet meter. History of the existing sensors is imported at startup.

data.pump_limit: Pumping limit (L left that the pump cannot draw, optional)

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Computed from the dimensions you entered; you can adjust it.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Re-import the source sensors' statistics into the tank and relearn the level to litres curve.

calibrate.name: Correct volume
calibrate.description: Tell the real tank volume now (litres or fill %). The level sensor must be in %. The value is fed to the learning.

config_entry.name: Tank
config_entry.description: Tank to correct (optional when there is only one).

percent.name: Real fill
percent.description: Real fill of the tank, in % of its capacity.

share_tank.name: Share settings
share_tank.description: Creates a notification with a link to a pre-filled GitHub issue (a custom tank to add to the catalogue, or the learned curve of a known tank to update). Nothing is sent automatically; limited to once per 24 h and only for tanks that have learned enough.
